# A Local set for Final Fantasy VIII's discs 1-3 (scripts/chains/ach_discswap_local.txt). Hit
# counts on an always-true condition: each fires a fixed number of evaluated frames after the
# load, whatever the game does, so the run shows which ones the set lived to award.
